messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliocare.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: evidence cadence and signature gating for HelioCare pilot

Hi Hannah / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here (Anil copied) is starting to map the internal review cycles. A couple asks to help us align on the MAP and close timeline: 

- Can you provide a simple MAP with milestone dates tied to the MSA / DPA / Order Form sign windows? Our legal team needs the gating windows to plan their reviews.
- We will need an evidence matrix for SOC2 and data-retention logs before procurement approval. Can you share the artifacts and an owner on your side for follow-ups?
- Target business date for go-live is 2027-01-10; is that realistic if signature occurs by 2026-12-10?

Quick note — procurement wants clear contingency: if DPA redlines push beyond 12/10 we may need a staggered order form signature.

Appreciate any templates.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
HelioCare

Attachment: map-request-heliocare-brief.txt (stated)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliocare.com>, Anil Rao <anil.rao@heliocare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence cadence and signature gating for HelioCare pilot

Maya / Anil —

Thanks — putting a concise MAP together and attaching a first-pass evidence checklist. High level:

1) Milestones (proposed)
   - 2026-11-19: MAP + evidence checklist (attached) — owner: Hannah (Redwood)
   - 2026-11-26: Legal review window opens (HelioCare legal)
   - 2026-12-03: Final redlines agreed / pricing sign-off (commercial owners)
   - 2026-12-10: Target exec signature (MSA + Order Form)
   - 2026-12-17: DPA sign window (we can do DPA parallel with signature but ask for 1-week buffer)
   - 2027-01-10: Go-live (pilot enablement)

2) Dependencies & gating
   - MSA must include the agreed SLA/uptime paragraph and the indemnity cap as discussed.
   - DPA review: we expect 2 business days for minor redlines, 5+ days for substantive changes.
   - Order Form: pricing & seat counts must be locked before signature cut.

3) Quick asks to HelioCare
   - Please confirm Procurement and Legal points of contact for each milestone (name + calendar availability).
   - Can you confirm if SOC2 Type II evidence will be accepted via a redacted report or do you require auditor contact?

Attaching: MAP-draft-heliocare.xlsx, evidence-checklist.pdf

I will loop Legal (Karthik) and Laura for procurement orchestration. If the 12/10 signature slips, we propose a staged order form (core product first, add-on billing after DPA) — see note in the MAP.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: MAP-draft-heliocare.xlsx, evidence-checklist.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@heliocare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence cadence + signature gating for HelioCare pilot

Thanks Hannah — quick legal perspective and a couple of asks so we don't block the 12/10 target: 

- DPA timing: we can run the DPA parallel to MSA signature but request an explicit fallback: if HelioCare needs to delay the DPA > 7 days post-signature we limit initial data access to non-PII sandboxing until DPA is completed. That avoids operational risk.
- Redline hotspots: data residency clause (Section 5), Subprocessor list (exhibit B), and SLA credit calculation. If HelioCare has required language for any of these, send it now so we can triage.
- Pricing contingency: Laura / Commercial to confirm if we can accept a preliminary PO and then amend for final seat count within 30 days post-signature. If not, we need a hard count pre-signature.

Forwarding an internal snippet for clarity:
> On Thu, 19 Nov 2026, Hannah Schmitt wrote:
> > Proposed milestone: 2026-12-10 signature (MSA + Order Form)
> > Proposed fallback: staged order form if DPA extends beyond 12/10

If HelioCare confirms flexibility on the DPA window or accepts the sandbox restriction, Legal will push to expedite comments.

-Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---
Note: suggested language for sandbox/data-limited interim appended as text (not attached).

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence cadence + signature gating for HelioCare pilot

Maya / Anil —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Action items summarized below so Procurement has a single list to drive internal approvals: 

1) HelioCare to confirm procurement and legal POCs (name + email + earliest review block) by EOD 2026-11-27.
2) HelioCare to confirm SOC2 acceptance criteria (redacted report OK vs auditor contact) by 2026-11-30.
3) Redwood to finalize pricing amendment language and confirm if preliminary PO + 30-day amendment is acceptable (Redwood commercial to reply 2026-11-27).
4) Legal: Karthik to deliver concise DPA fallback language by 2026-11-26 (attached in MMP-v1.pdf).
5) DocuSign: once redlines are settled we'll send a single DocuSign bundle for MSA + Order Form; DPA will be either included or linked depending on HelioCare preference.

If all items above land on the requested dates we should preserve the 2026-12-10 signature target and retain 2027-01-10 for pilot go-live. If HelioCare needs a longer DPA review, we recommend signing MSA + Order Form for the limited pilot (non-PII) and executing full DPA within 14 days post-signature.

Attached: MMP-v1.pdf (mutual milestone plan with dates)

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
